coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the variable-category level, 3 of 7 ground-truth items are represented: training regime, contrasting game rules, and reasoning benchmark performance (43%, rounded). The latter two matches are incomplete.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes Llama-3/Mistral for LLaMA-2-7B/Baichuan-2-13B, does not vary learning rates and KL coefficients as specified, and omits fixed batch size 128, sequence length 2048, and explicit shared dataset splits. It replaces much of the benchmark suite and omits geometric mean scores. Gameplay diagnostics do not capture the specified attacker-versus-defender win rates and non-adversarial success results. Its Taboo formulation also introduces a cooperative guessing team and an additional adversarial component rather than faithfully specifying the intended adversarial game.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion that SPAG should outperform non-adversarial approaches.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No predicted conclusion was supplied; hypotheses and conditional statements within design_output do not fill the separate conclusion_output field.
